title: Get recommended interest and action categories
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get recommended interest and action categories based on historical performance data in the same industries. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{22%}|v1.2{40%}|v1.3{38%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/tools/target_recommend_tags/|/v1.3/tool/targeting_category/recommend/| |Request parameter name|`region_code`|`region_codes`| |Request parameter data type |`app_id`: number|`app_id`: string| |Response parameter name|
  • `name` (in the `interest_categories` object)
  • `name`(in the `action_categories` object )
  • `placement`
  • `industry_types` |
    • ` interest_category_name`
    • `action_category_name`
    • `placements`
    • `special_industries` | |Response parameter name and data type|
      • `id` (in the `interest_categories` object): number
      • `id`(in the `action_categories` object): number |
        • `interest_category_id`: string
        • `action_category_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/targeting_category/recommend/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162). | |Content-Type {required}|string|The content type of the request. Allowed value: `"application/json"`| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {required}|string| Advertiser ID. | |region_codes {required}|string[]|List of country or region codes. For example: `["US", "JP", "KR"]`| |app_id|string|ID of the mobile app that you want to promote. This field in optional and only valid if you want to promote a mobile app.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "region_code": [ "REGION_CODE" ], "app_id": "APP_ID" }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/targeting_category/recommend/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of error codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string| The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Returned data.| #|interest_categories|object[]|Recommended interest categories.| ##|interest_category_id|string|Interest category ID. It can used as one of the targeting settings when creating an ad group.| ##|interest_category_name|string| Interest category name.| ##|placements|string[]|List of placements that the interest categories can be used. If blank is returned, it means the interest category can be used in all placements.| ##|special_industries|string[]|Ad categories. Enum values:
          • `HOUSING`: Ads for real estate listings, homeowners insurance, mortgage loans or other related opportunities.
          • `EMPLOYMENT`: Ads for job offers, internship, professional certification programs or other related opportunities.
          • `CREDIT`: Ads for credit card offers, auto loans, long-term financing or other related opportunities.

          Note:

          • If the returned value is empty(`[]`), it means that the interest categories do not support any industry types.
          • This field is only supported for advertisers who are registered in America or Canada.
          | #|action_categories|object[]|Recommended action categories.| ##|action_category_id|string|Action category ID. It can be used as one of the targeting settings when creating an ad group.| ##|action_category_name|string| Action category name.| ##|description|string|Action category description.| ##|scene|string|Action category scene. Enum values: `CREATOR_RELATED`, `VIDEO_RELATED`.| ##|special_industries|string[]|Ad categories. Enum values:
          • `HOUSING`: Ads for real estate listings, homeowners insurance, mortgage loans or other related opportunities.
          • `EMPLOYMENT`: Ads for job offers, internship, professional certification programs or other related opportunities.
          • `CREDIT`: Ads for credit card offers, auto loans, long-term financing or other related opportunities.

          Note:

          • If the returned value is empty(`[]`), it means that the interest categories do not support any industry types.
          • This field is only supported for advertisers who are registered in America or Canada.
          | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "20220614231448010245246039155606FD", "data": { "interest_categories": [ { "interest_category_id": "11", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "placements": [], "interest_category_name": "Vehicles & Transportation" }, { "interest_category_id": "20", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "placements": [], "interest_category_name": "Apps" }, { "interest_category_id": "23117104", "special_industries": [], "placement": [ "PLACEMENT_TIKTOK", "PLACEMENT_PANGLE" ], "interest_category_name": "Talk Shows" }, { "interest_category_id": "20105", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "placement": [], "interest_category_name": "Online Shopping" }, { "interest_category_id": "10", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "placement": [], "interest_category_name": "Education" }, { "interest_category_id": "26105", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "placement": [], "interest_category_name": "Housekeeping" } ], "action_categories": [ { "action_category_name": "Fitness & Health", "action_category_id": "21", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "description": "TikTok users who have followed healthy lifestyle or fitness creators.", "scene": "CREATOR_RELATED" }, { "action_category_name": "Other Transportation and Vehicle", "action_category_id": "22002", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "description": "TikTok users who have followed creators that post content about other types of transportation vehicles.", "scene": "CREATOR_RELATED" }, { "action_category_name": "Selfie", "action_category_id": "27001", "special_industries": [ "HOUSING", "EMPLOYMENT", "CREDIT" ], "description": "TikTok users who have followed creators that post selfies.", "scene": "CREATOR_RELATED" } ] } } (/code); ```
